description:
Priority: P1 (layout/process). Files: .story/config.json, roadmap.json, status.json, tickets/, sessions/, handovers/, lessons/, notes/, snapshots/, channel-inbox/, .gitignore. Reference: metricstore/keystore (fullest non-aviary examples).

Problem: The template was the only repo with no .story/ directory; the session-tracking workflow had no home.

NOTE: This ticket is now partly self-fulfilling — storybloq_init has already created the .story/ skeleton (config.json, roadmap.json, tickets/, issues/, handovers/, notes/, lessons/). Remaining work: verify the directory set against a sibling (metricstore/keystore), add any missing dirs (sessions/, snapshots/, channel-inbox/), and ensure .story/.gitignore matches the fleet convention (snapshots/, sessions/, status.json ignored).

Acceptance: .story/ exists with the full directory set; the Story skill (/story) loads the project without errors.
title: [TPL-013] Round out the .story/ workspace scaffold
